description: v1 draft. PIXEL-SAMPLED from design/reference/varden/varden_sheet.webp (1536x1024): the six palette chips (centre 13x13 medians at y=902: navy #373a42, dark brown #504743, grey-taupe #7a6c60, cream #b79c7c, gold #ba8f52, steel teal #4f6168) + masked percentile samples off the head panel (skin = hue 11-40 deg / sat > 0.3 pixels of the cheeks + forehead box x1185-1245 y105-175, 85th / 15th luminance percentile = lit / shadow; hair x1090-1250 y58-108 sat < 0.4; beard x1140-1240 y185-240; grey streak = sat < 0.3 / value > 0.45 pixels of the chin box; iris = the pixels inside the left iris) and off the figures / detail panels (fur, cloak, leather, gold, boots, grip: masked medians / percentiles). Values derived (not on the sheet) are marked 'derived'. No glow: the sheet shows none.

skin.note: SAMPLED #9b7557: lit cheek / forehead (85th pct) -- weathered warm tan

skin_shadow.note: SAMPLED #836047: the face's 15th pct (authored jaw / neck cast shadow)

lips.note: derived: a step paler + less saturated than skin (the house rule)

mouth.note: derived: the one mouth line (the sheet's mouth stroke tone)

lash.note: SAMPLED: the upper lid line pixels (#382716..#3e3228)

brow.note: SAMPLED #5e4938: the heavy brows (dark pixels of the brow box)

face_line.note: derived: painted age lines, a soft step darker than skin

scar.note: SAMPLED #a07858 lifted one step: the pale healed scar line

beard_inner.note: v4: the zone UNDER the beard shell, seen only as the thin strip at the shell's sunk edge -- set between beard_root #513e34 and beard_fade1 so that strip continues the fade instead of outlining it (v3: [70, 54, 44], derived from the beard 15th pct, one step darker)

beard_fade1.note: v4 derived: stubble fade step 1 (next to the beard shell) = beard_inner -> skin 0.30 (sRGB lerp)

beard_fade2.note: v4 derived: stubble fade step 2 = beard_inner -> skin 0.55

beard_fade3.note: v4 derived: stubble fade step 3 (outermost, serrated) = beard_inner -> skin 0.78

eye_sclera.note: SAMPLED #d4bda5 (the one clean sclera pixel) lifted: warm off-white

hair.note: SAMPLED: hair box median #685749 lifted toward the grey lights -- grey-brown

hair_shade.note: derived from the hair 15th pct #55463c: lock undersides

hair_ring.note: derived from the grey lights: angel ring

hair_tip.note: SAMPLED #7e786c: the low-saturation grey lights (the greying tips)

hair_inner.note: derived: the DARK inner cap (Wren ratio inner / hair ~0.55)

hair_grey.note: v5 SAMPLED: the scalp GREY STREAK -- head panel side hair, sat < 0.25 / value > 0.5 pixels (median #837c70; 22 % of the side hair vs 4-8 % top / front)

hair_grey_tip.note: v5 derived: the grey streak lighter tips (toward the panel top highlights #b0a293)

hair_beard.note: SAMPLED #695343: the beard median (a step warmer / darker than the hair)

hair_beard_tip.note: derived between the beard median and the 85th pct #8c6c55

hair_beard_grey.note: SAMPLED #8f7a66: the GREY STREAK (chin, sat < 0.3, value > 0.45 pixels)

hair_beard_grey_tip.note: derived: the grey streak's lighter tips

tunic.note: SAMPLED #343237 (the tunic skirt panel median) ~ the navy chip, a touch darker than the cloak

tunic_trim.note: CHIP gold #ba8f52: collar / skirt / tabard edges

tabard.note: CHIP cream #b79c7c: the white tabard panel (the sheet paints it cream-shaded)

sleeve_roll.note: SAMPLED #cdb89b: the sleeve's lit puffs (85th pct)

boot_trim.note: CHIP gold: the cuff's gold edge

belt.note: SAMPLED #503f35 (= the dark-brown chip #504743 family): wide belt / sword belt

brass.note: CHIP gold #ba8f52: buckles, studs, brooch, crest, motifs, stars, chain, chape

brass_dark.note: SAMPLED #8e6b47: gold median off the sword / emblem panels (grooves)

gem_teal.note: CHIP steel teal #4f6168: the brooch pendant gem (paint, no glow)

cloak.note: CHIP navy #373a42 (cloak back median #38373c agrees): the huge cloak

fur.note: SAMPLED: fur median #473f3b lifted toward the dark-brown chip #504743

fur_inner.note: derived: the dark under-fur roll (gaps read as deep fur)

steel.note: derived from the steel-teal chip #4f6168, lifted to a blade value (blade unseen on the sheet: sheathed)

gem_dark.note: derived: the dark pommel gem (sheet: blue-black)

scabbard.note: derived from the sword-panel darks #373331: dark scabbard

material.note: the house shaded material: Col x baked AO, baked normal map; no cel bands, no outline shells; no emitters
